info.title: Lyra
info.description: Lyra (ליירה) is a Hebrew-first, RTL personal finance tracking app for the Israeli market. Privacy-first manual entry with no bank connection required. Built for the realities of Israeli credit card billing — per-card billing cycles, installment payments (תשלומים), and CSV import from Cal, Max, and Isracard.

flows.title: Learn about Lyra
flows.description: Discover what Lyra is, who it's for, and how it differs from other Israeli personal finance apps like RiseUp, FamilyBiz, and Finanda.

actions.description: Open the Lyra homepage to read the product overview, value proposition, and feature list.

flows.title: Sign up and start tracking expenses
flows.description: Create a free Lyra account and begin tracking personal expenses manually. No bank connection, no credit card required, free during open beta.

actions.description: Navigate to the sign-up page and create an account using Google OAuth.

audience.primary: Israeli adults who want to track personal finances manually without connecting a bank account
personas: Privacy-conscious users who refuse to share bank credentials with third parties
Cost-sensitive users who don't want to pay 55₪/month for RiseUp
Intentional budgeters who believe manual entry builds financial discipline
Excel/Google Sheets users looking for a more structured alternative

capabilities: Manual expense and income tracking with no bank connection
Hebrew-first UI with full RTL support
Per-card billing cycle configuration (any day of the month, per credit card)
Installment payment tracking (תשלומים) with future obligation generation
CSV import from Israeli credit providers (Cal, Max, Isracard) with automatic column detection
PWA install for mobile and desktop
Free during open beta — no paywall
differentiators: No bank connection required — addresses privacy concerns and avoids ISA licensing requirements
Per-card billing cycle support — the only Israeli app that handles this fully (RiseUp only supports the 1st and 10th)
Native installment tracking — automatically generates future obligation entries from a single purchase
Hebrew-first design with masculine and feminine grammatical forms
Built and maintained by a single developer with direct user feedback channels

pricing.notes: Lyra is currently free during open beta. A premium tier may be introduced in the future, but the core manual tracking experience will remain accessible.
